```{r}
library(dplyr)

f <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/01_data/tm3_small_scale_seq_set1_1_repl_gwas_trail/BTR67725-2122_0_R16179_20231216/demultiplexed/BTR67725-2122_0_ALL_10u0x10x0N0_demux_stats.tab"

min_vol <- 1; max_vol <- 15
old_vol <- 1          # volume per sample in the trial pool (vector if it varied)

reads <- read.delim(f) %>%
  filter(type == "sample", !id %in% c("lane", "ALL_10u0x10x0N0")) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, name, count)

#Anchor on median (or max; depends on the decision )
target <- median(reads$count[reads$count > 0])    

reads <- reads %>%
  mutate(
    fold      = count / target,
    raw_vol   = old_vol * target / pmax(count, 1),
    vol       = round(pmin(pmax(raw_vol, min_vol), max_vol), 1),
    capped    = raw_vol > max_vol,                 # will stay under-represented
    failed    = fold < 1 / max_vol,                # consider re-prep / exclude
    pred_reads = count * vol / old_vol             # expected relative yield
  )

# sanity checks
summary(reads$fold)
summary(reads$pred_reads / median(reads$pred_reads))   # should be ~1 for most
sum(reads$vol)                                         # total pool volume
reads %>% filter(capped | failed)

write.table(dplyr::select(reads, id, name, count, vol, capped, failed),
            sub("\\.tab$", "_repool_volumes.tsv", f),
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
```
